# Connector fixtures

Every request and response in this directory was authored for testing. No file is a captured,
cached, or redistributed source payload. The official-looking endpoints in request
definitions exercise host and connector routing; the test suite does not contact them.

`manifest.json` exhaustively lists each fixture and its SHA-256 digest. Changing a fixture requires
an intentional manifest update and connector test review.

These fixtures demonstrate parser behavior only. They are not evidence of provider permission,
availability, accuracy, endorsement, commercial-use rights, caching rights, redistribution rights,
or production fitness. Current source terms and applicable law always control.
